dedupe_keys.name: historical watershed stressors for the laurentian great lakes

description: This PANGAEA deposit contains historical human-pressure data for 60 watersheds in the Laurentian Great Lakes basin, compiled by the associated Great Lakes research team. Archival records were transcribed into annual population, mining, deforestation and agricultural measures for 1780–2010. The landing page provides a downloadable tab-delimited resource index and links to the underlying material under CC-BY-3.0, free of charge. These series can supply changing land-use and activity assumptions for catchment water-quality simulations or historical water-demand scenarios. They complement present-day watershed observations by representing the development of pressures over more than two centuries. The repository page does not establish the underlying file formats, uncertainty bounds or spatial detail below watershed level. Historical transcription and uneven archival evidence therefore limit comparisons across years. This record covers the stressor collection, not unrelated contemporary Great Lakes ecological datasets returned by broad name matching.
